narrative.overview: Selected Elegant Service List home and compact Porcelain Bar remain the visual authority. Seven inner routes and three articles extend the blush and burgundy system with Cormorant display and Sofia Sans body. Home remains fixed; inner pages scroll naturally. Navigation, service links, booking, gallery, mobile menu, and course FAQs work. The contact form is preview-only.
